FN-TUHW19-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 183
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Troy Stubbs
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/03/2023
House Bill 183 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Administrative Office of the
Courts (AOC), funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated $1.01 million for fiscal year
2025, and an estimated minimum of $1.35 million each fiscal year thereafter, to create three
additional circuit court judgeships (one each in 19th, 23rd, and 28th Judicial Circuits).
